strongest_verified_result: For all n,d >= 1, simple graphs on the same labeled vertex set yield equal full connected sign-preserving stress-fiber partitions of (R^d)^n if and only if their edge sets agree, with collisions included.
reconstruction_rule: An unordered pair is an edge exactly when its collision diagonal is a union of entire strata.
mechanism: A present edge is detected by its positive singleton-support stress at a collision; for an absent edge, a collinear path crosses that collision with a positive diagonal transport of the fixed incidence kernel, so the whole path lies in one connected stratum.
connected_component_issue: resolved by the full continuous interval image inside one fiber-equivalence class
exact_remaining_gap: The source does not separately define cross-graph sameness; independent priority and interpretation audits are still required. A path and star on four vertices are nonisomorphic yet ambient-linearly equivalent as full stratified spaces, so an alternative ambient interpretation has a materially different classification.
publication_requirement: State literal equality of subsets of the fixed labeled full base prominently and credit Panina Section 3 Lemma 4 for the collision detector. This review alone does not permit an unqualified original-problem solution claim.
